description: 1. Agent must read SKILL.md to discover the sync script at `~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/obsidian-folder-sync/scripts/sync.sh`. 2. Agent must invoke the script with the correct 3-argument signature: `bash ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/obsidian-folder-sync/scripts/sync.sh /workspace/bioproject/pipeline-docs /workspace/ObsidianVault BioPipeline2024`. The third argument `BioPipeline2024` is critical — without reading the docs, the agent won't know this optional positional argument controls the vault subdirectory name. 3. The script (as documented) uses `rsync --files-from` and only copies `*.md` files, automatically excluding `node_modules/`, `__pycache__/`, `.git/`, `.venv/`, `.clawhub/`, and `.learnings/` directories — the agent must trust the script and NOT attempt a generic rsync or manual copy. 4. The proprietary trap is the `.clawhub/` and `.learnings/` exclusions, which are non-standard and only documented in SKILL.md. 5. The log file is auto-written to `~/.openclaw/workspace/logs/obsidian-folder-sync.log` as a side-effect of using the correct script. 6. An agent that uses generic `rsync` or `cp` directly will fail checks for: wrong subdirectory name, leaked excluded-dir .md files, missing log file at the proprietary path.
